name: vamp
tagline: all black, leather flares, looks like you sleep in a coffin (you might)
description: The Opium-inspired look that grew out of Playboi Carti's Whole Lotta Red era: black leather, flared denim, stacked silver, platform boots and a gothic, almost theatrical edge. Ken Carson and Destroy Lonely made it a uniform; the underground copied it fast.
